integrity: All claims are supported by the stated elementary case analysis and reproducible finite-field checks; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Claims concern reduced geometric sets, not scheme-theoretic reducedness. The classification is for strictly upper-triangular 5x5 Lie matrices only; Kobal 2005 full text was inaccessible, so an indirect or unlocated prior theorem remains possible.
title: Characteristic-sensitive sandwich loci of the five-by-five niltriangular Lie algebra
